schema.name: Fivetran_CL
schema.description: Fivetran platform and connector logs pushed via the Azure Monitor Logs Ingestion API (DCR-based custom table).

columns.name: TimeGenerated
columns.description: Log Analytics ingestion timestamp, derived from CreatedAt in the DCR transform.

columns.name: Level
columns.description: Log level reported by Fivetran (INFO, WARNING, SEVERE).

columns.name: CreatedAt
columns.description: Timestamp of the log event as sent by Fivetran.
